summary: Creates a video dynacast manager with optional downgrade debounce, shared base behavior, and per-codec video quality trackers.
summary_step: 1. Fills a default logger when none is supplied.
2. Initializes desired and committed max-subscribed-quality maps.
3. Creates a debounce function when DynacastPauseDelay is configured.
4. Creates the shared dynacast manager base with video-specific restart, quality creation, codec regression, and update callbacks.
5. Resets committed quality state on restart and creates dynacastQualityVideo instances for MIME types.
6. Maps regressed source codecs to OFF and ensures target codecs are enabled at high quality when needed.
7. Returns the video manager as a DynacastManager.

summary: Forces all committed video codecs to the supplied max quality and enqueues a listener update.

summary: Notifies the per-codec video quality tracker that one subscriber requested a maximum quality.
Notifies per-codec video quality trackers about maximum quality reported by a downstream node.
Updates desired max subscribed quality for a MIME type and triggers manager update processing.
Commits changed video max subscribed quality state, optionally debouncing downgrade-only changes.
summary_step: 1. Locks manager state and logs desired and committed quality maps.
2. Returns when no codec has been added yet.
3. Detects changed quality state and whether the change is downgrade-only.
4. Returns when no change exists and force is false.
5. When downgrade-only and debounce is configured, schedules or waits for a forced update and returns without committing.
6. Clears any debounce callback before sending an update.
7. Copies desired max quality into committed state and enqueues subscribed quality change notification.

summary: Builds subscribed video codec protos and max quality values from committed state, then enqueues the listener callback.
summary_step: 1. Returns when the manager is closed or has no listener.
2. Converts committed max quality state into SubscribedCodec protos and SubscribedCodecQuality values.
3. Emits disabled low/medium/high qualities when a codec is OFF.
4. Emits enabled qualities up to the committed max quality otherwise.
5. Logs the outgoing subscription state and enqueues OnDynacastSubscribedMaxQualityChange on the notification queue.
